t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Yellow yields higher mushroom counts. Hats of the gnomes correspond to that of the baskets.

vb_textbox.text: The arrow keys only need to be tapped once. The colours of hats will match either a red or yellow basket. After you work out which baskets are for which colours, always try and get the yellow basket. Streaks of this are good for points. Eventually you will reach a 0 for this streak. Once this happens switch to the red baskets instead. Keep doing this!
